test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 13 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.

When William gets angry, he starts to act like an __imbecile.__
solution: The correct answer is '**Intelligent**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The given word is '**Imbecile**' and it means a stupid person. **(मूर्ख व्‍यक्ति)** • **​Example- **He drank too much and started acting like a complete **imbecile**. • The correct answer is '**Intelligent**' and it means having or showing the ability to understand, learn and think; clever. (**समझने, सीखने और सोचने की क्षमता से संपन्‍न, बुद्धिमान; चतुर**) • Example- All their children are very **intelligent**.​ • It is clear from the above explanations that the correct answer is 'Intelligent'. Therefore, the correct answer is **'Option 4'**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Cheerful **means feeling happy; showing that you are happy. **(प्रसन्‍न, प्रमुदित; हँसमुख)** • **Pleasing **means giving you pleasure and satisfaction. **(सुखकर और संतोषप्रद)** • **Fierce **means angry, aggressive and frightening. **(क्रुद्घ, आक्रामक और डरावना; बर्बर)** ff:Ta04, The correct answer is **'Option 4.'**
